title: Authorization Request
description: A transport-neutral request to Auth. The Gateway uses it for incoming requests and the Agent Loop uses it before every tool call. Permissions are evaluated by Auth only (D176).

actor_id.description: Stable identity ID returned by authentication.

resource.description: Resource being accessed. Open-ended names include tool:read_file, memory:/life/finances/*, and system:change_settings.

action.description: Requested action. Open-ended names include read, write, delete, execute, delegate, approve, and configure.

context.description: Request-specific facts Auth may use for scoped policies, limits, approvals, or audit detail.

correlation_id.description: End-to-end request correlation ID. Auth includes it in the audit record.
